text:
alyssa: Heads up — after yesterday's main merge I'm seeing a ~2x p99 decode latency spike on the canary. CI perf tests failed on 2/3 runs. Repro on canary so far.

mike: I can confirm. Profiling shows a huge uptick in KV evictions and a collapse in avg batch size. Quick numbers from a canary run:

```
p50 decode: 45ms -> 48ms
p95 decode: 110ms -> 200ms
p99 decode: 120ms -> 240ms

kv_stats:
  evictions: 43 -> 790
  cache_hits: 87% -> 52%
batching:
  avg_batch_size: 6.2 -> 2.1
  batch_count: 410 -> 1800
```

sophia: Flamegraph + traces: https://ci.internal/runs/190000/flamegraph — looks like the adaptive batching threshold change from PR #2389 is fragmenting short requests into micro-batches, which in turn busts the KV cache hot prefixes.

jordan: @mike can you run a git bisect? I have a hunch the attention kernel selector fallback in runtime PR #2405 made the runtime take a slower kernel when kv_size > 0, but the batching heuristic change could be the root cause too.

mike: Starting bisect now. Local repro command: `./tests/perf/run_workload --profile chat-100k --repeat 10`. Using `git bisect start --bad HEAD --good v2026-01-10`. Will report which PR lands the regression.

ci-bot: CI Perf failing build: https://ci.internal/builds/190234 — test `perf/decode_latency` reported p99 +112ms (threshold +50ms).

mike: Bisect narrowed it to PR 2389 (adaptive-batching heuristic). Reverting that change locally brings p99 back to ~125ms and kv evictions drop to ~60.

alyssa: Let's pause the canary rollout until we have a fix. @deploy-bot please pause the canary for us. :warning:

deploy-bot: Canary paused for cluster `us-east-1-canary`.

sophia: Confirming revert test on canary after local revert: avg_batch_size returns to ~6, kv_evictions ~55, p99 back within baseline. Suggest we revert PR 2389 in prod and follow up with a combined solution: tune adaptive threshold + add guardrails in kernel selector so it doesn't choose the slow fallback for common short-chat patterns.

jordan: Filed rollback PR #2411 to revert the adaptive batching change. Also adding extra logging around batch formation and KV heuristics (will attach a small perf test in CI that runs the short-seq chat workload). Assigning follow-up to @sophia and @mike.

alyssa: Nice triage. Two asks before unpausing: 1) a targeted unit/regression perf test in CI for short-seq workload (assert `avg_batch >= 3` and `kv_evictions < 100`), 2) a small kernel-selector tweak and additional telemetry so we can observe when the fallback is picked. :thumbsup:

mike: On it — will send a follow-up PR with the CI test + temporary debug metrics.

sophia: I'll take the kernel-selector telemetry and a patch to the heuristic thresholds. We'll coordinate on the follow-up PRs and re-run the canary once both are in.
